algorithm: Accumulate touched 4 KiB RAM pages until eight consecutive natural calls add no new page.
At the next natural entry, snapshot every discovered page and every QEMU-exposed register.
Run the native call and retain its ordered access values plus exit state.
If discovery coverage and snapshots are complete, restore entry memory and writable registers, then redirect the same vCPU to the kernel entry.
Compare shadow access values, exit registers, and final memory against the native call; restore the native exit state before resuming the caller.
fail_closed_conditions: new native page outside the discovery footprint aborts before replay
process exit before the shadow call completes

stock_audio_target.workload: generated slot-1 sample with held Trig 1

development_observations: Exact-byte discovery expanded with the moving sample cursor and correctly aborted before replay.
Page-granular snapshots closed the moving-address gap after eight stable calls.
Untouched co-resident page bytes can change outside the kernel contract; final comparison is therefore limited to the union of bytes actually accessed by the kernel.
next_gate: Implement an optional whole-loop helper for the independently validated 16-iteration MAC/MSAC boundary, retaining native execution as the differential oracle and fallback.

github_actions.policy: Validate locally and publish with [skip ci].

safety: The committed fixture is original synthetic ColdFire code. Aggregate reports contain no guest addresses or values. No Elektron firmware, project data, sample names, PCM, or runtime trace is committed.
